property_summary: For any bytes4 selector, c.supportsInterface returns true exactly for the IAccessControl interface id or the IERC165 interface id, and in particular always returns true for the IAccessControl id computed from its member function selectors; the mutant only supports IERC165 and thus returns false for the IAccessControl id.
change_summary: Remove the IAccessControl check so only IERC165 (via super) is reported as supported.
